decks.notes: This deck focuses on quickly playing aggressive creatures like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Murktide Regent while disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells like Force of Will and Daze. It also utilizes efficient card draw and manipulation with Brainstorm, Ponder, and Expressive Iteration to maintain tempo and pressure the opponent. The mana base is constructed to support the deck's aggressive strategy, with Wasteland providing additional disruption and color fixing, while Brazen Borrower offers versatility and protection. The deck aims to control the game through early aggression and disruption, pushing towards a quick victory.

The main concept of this UR Tempo deck is to utilize efficient creatures like Delver of Secrets, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Murktide Regent to apply early pressure on the opponent while disrupting their game plan with countermagic like Daze and Force of Will. The deck aims to maintain tempo by utilizing cantrips like Brainstorm and Ponder to dig for threats and answers. The mana base is designed to support both the aggressive game plan with Wasteland and Lightning Bolt, as well as the control aspect with Mystic Sanctuary and Steam Vents.

This deck focuses on using Cloudpost and Tron lands to ramp up mana quickly and drop powerful threats like Eldrazi Titans onto the battlefield. It utilizes cards like Expedition Map and Crop Rotation to find key lands, while also including utility creatures like Reclamation Sage and Endurance for disruption. The deck aims to control the game with cards like Pithing Needle and Primeval Titan, while also having access to toolbox cards like Green Sun's Zenith. Overall, the strategy revolves around quickly ramping up mana and overwhelming the opponent with big threats.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through counter spells and removal while utilizing card advantage and library manipulation. With a mix of counterspells, removal spells, and powerful planeswalkers, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan and establish dominance through card advantage. The inclusion of Hullbreacher and Narset, Parter of Veils provides additional disruption and card draw denial. The deck also includes a variety of lands to ensure consistent mana fixing and access to the necessary colors for spells.

The main focus of this deck is to use artifacts to generate mana and card advantage, while also utilizing blue spells for control. The deck aims to quickly generate a board presence with cheap artifact creatures like Sai and Emry, while also disrupting the opponent's strategy with cards like Chalice of the Void and Force of Will. The inclusion of Urza's Saga provides additional artifact synergy, allowing the deck to further outvalue the opponent and overwhelm them with an aggressive artifact-based strategy.

The main concept of this Doomsday combo deck is to efficiently control the game with counterspells and removal spells while setting up a win condition using Doomsday to stack the deck in a way that allows Thassa's Oracle to win the game on the spot. The deck aims to quickly assemble the necessary pieces to cast Doomsday, manipulate the top of the deck effectively to secure the win, and protect the combo with disruption spells like Force of Will and Duress. It is a resourceful and strategic deck that can win in a single turn if executed correctly.

This deck focuses on assembling the Dark Depths combo as quickly as possible to create a 20/20 Marit Lage token, overwhelming the opponent with a powerful threat. It utilizes cards like Crop Rotation and Green Sun's Zenith to quickly tutor for the combo pieces, while also having versatile removal and utility cards like Swords to Plowshares and Sylvan Library to control the game. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while setting up its own win condition efficiently and effectively.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly deploy strong creatures like Delver of Secrets, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Murktide Regent while disrupting the opponent's game plan with efficient counterspells like Daze and Force of Will. The deck aims to maintain tempo by controlling the board with Lightning Bolt and Wasteland, while also generating card advantage through cards like Brazen Borrower and Expressive Iteration. The mana base is streamlined for consistency, with fetch lands and dual lands providing access to all the necessary colors.

This deck focuses on utilizing a variety of control elements to disrupt the opponent's strategy while gradually building card advantage and maintaining board presence. By combining powerful removal spells, counterspells, and card draw along with versatile planeswalkers and resilient threats, the deck aims to outvalue the opponent and control the flow of the game. The deck also includes a land base that enables versatile mana fixing and graveyard recursion, allowing for flexibility in responding to various threats and situations.

The deck focuses on quickly deploying artifact creatures and leveraging the synergy between artifacts and blue spells. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with counter spells like Force of Will while generating value through cards like Sai, Master Thopterist and Thought Monitor. Urza's Saga is a key card in the deck as it can tutor for important artifacts like Chalice of the Void or Mishra's Bauble. The deck is designed to apply pressure early and close out the game before the opponent can stabilize.

The main idea of this deck is to focus on a fast and explosive combo strategy by consistently casting a series of spells that allow you to quickly reach your win condition. Using cards like Dark Ritual, Cabal Ritual, and Lotus Petal to generate mana quickly, you aim to cast Thassa's Oracle or Dread Return to win the game with little to no interaction from your opponent. The deck's key strength lies in its ability to quickly assemble its combo pieces and execute a win in a rapid manner.

The main goal of this deck is to deal damage to the opponent as quickly and efficiently as possible using low-cost aggressive creatures and direct burn spells. By overwhelming the opponent with a steady stream of damage, the deck aims to chip away at their life total at a rapid pace, often sacrificing resources like lands with cards like Fireblast to maximize damage output. The mana base is streamlined to ensure consistent access to red mana for casting spells, with the ability to deal additional damage over time with enchantments like Sulfuric Vortex.

The deck focuses on using disruptive creatures like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Spirit of the Labyrinth to slow down opponents while leveraging Aether Vial to put them into play quickly. Stoneforge Mystic and Recruiter of the Guard help to search for key equipment like Swords to Plowshares and Batterskull, while Skyclave Apparition and Flickerwisp provide removal and disruption. Karakas and Wasteland are used for additional disruption, and Urza's Saga helps to search for important artifacts like Kaldra Compleat. The deck aims to control the board and overwhelm opponents with efficient creatures and equipment.

The deck focuses on quickly generating mana and card advantage by playing a variety of small Elves that can tap for multiple mana. The goal is to use cards like Glimpse of Nature and Heritage Druid to chain together spells and draw through the deck, eventually finding a win condition like Craterhoof Behemoth or Natural Order to close out the game. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Collector Ouphe and Endurance to interact with the opponent's game plan and protect its own combo.

The deck focuses on combining Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage to create a 20/20 flying indestructible Marit Lage token. It utilizes cards like Crop Rotation, Green Sun's Zenith, and Knight of the Reliquary to fetch the combo pieces quickly. The deck also includes land destruction with cards like Wasteland to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of utility lands like Bojuka Bog and Karakas provides additional flexibility and protection. Overall, the deck aims to assemble the combo quickly while disrupting the opponent's strategy through land destruction and utility lands.

The main concept of this deck is to establish early board presence with efficient threats like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler, while disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells like Force of Will and Daze. The deck aims to control the game tempo by leveraging powerful card selection and manipulation through Brainstorm, Ponder, and Expressive Iteration. The inclusion of Lightning Bolt and other burn spells provides additional reach and removal options. Additionally, the mana base includes Wasteland for land disruption and flexible fetch lands for color fixing.
